title: Blake Lively sheds insight into her wild beauty regimen
text: Blake Lively sheds insight into her wild beauty regimen The actress took to her Instagram Story to share a candid snapshot of her nighttime routine to maintain her 'natural beauty.' Blake Lively revealed the secrets of the beauty regimen she uses to look as if she's in the 'first trimester of life' on Wednesday evening. The 39-year-old actress took to her Instagram Story to share a candid clip of the nighttime routine she uses to maintain her 'natural beauty.' She appeared to be wearing headgear with red-light therapy over her hair, in addition to a sheet mask with extra pieces she had pasted to her bare face. The Gossip Girl alumna was also bundled up in a brown fleece hoodie while seemingly winding down for the night with her beauty routine. Lively gave a glimpse into her cozy wind-down routine shortly after the drama involving her film It Ends With Us and her director and costar Justin Baldoni.'Natural beauty is effortless,' she quipped at the bottom of her post, which pictured her taking a deep breath while the mask covered her face. Blake Lively, 39, revealed the secrets of the beauty regimen she uses to look as if she's in the 'first trimester of life' on Wednesday evening; above in August 2024 in London The actress took to her Instagram Story to share a candid clip of the nighttime routine she uses to maintain her 'natural beauty' Lively also drew thought bubbles around her face, and in one, she wrote: 'If I don't look like I'm in the first trimester of life after this much effort I quit.' She continued: 'I miss the 2000s when we just used that handsoap with fish characters on it on our face & called it a day. ' The Gossip GIrl star also noted the lights in the background of her room in another thought bubble: 'My kids' star projector that I stole is a vibe tho.' The mother of four – who shares James, 11; Inez, ten; Betty, seven; and Olin, three, with her husband Ryan Reynolds – often shares snippets of her hair and beauty routines on social media.In August, she shared a video of herself getting ready in her bathroom before rushing out the door as a busy mother and businesswoman.'The look: no time but need to look cute while ALSO raising children,' the movie star, who was seen using products from her Blake Brown haircare brand, wrote over the clip. Her post comes after she was in a legal battle with Baldoni, and the former costars settled right before their trial was set to begin. Baldoni was ultimately ordered to pay $400,000 of Lively's legal fees. Lively previously sued Baldoni and his production company Wayfarer in December 2024.Right before their trial was set to begin earlier this year, Lively was awarded just over $400,000 of the $8 million she sought in legal fees from their dispute due to his countersuit. In her lawsuit, Lively asserted that she was subjected to sexual harassment as well as retaliation, alleging he orchestrated a smear campaign to harm her reputation after she brought up complaints about his behavior on set.In response, Baldoni denied harassment and claimed Lively made complaints to seize creative control of the movie. In June 2025, the countersuit was thrown out. In May of this year, just two weeks before the scheduled trial date, the former costars reached their settlement. They also released a joint statement, writing that they 'remain firmly committed to workplaces free of improprieties and unproductive environments. '
